sections.text:
[Effects]
Increases physical and magic Ability Power by 6XL.
Ignores 50% of the target's DEF and MDEF (cannot be stacked).
Increases damage when using a physical or magic attack Ability by S+.
Target: yourself. Recovers 15 Cost.
Increases physical and magic attack Ability success value by M.
Ability Power scales with the number of Dark elemental Weapons equipped up to a max of 7XL (Gear pieces needed for maximum effect: 3).

[Activation]
When a physical or magic attack Ability is used.

[Activation Rate]
L+
Activation rate scales with the number of Dark elemental Weapons equipped up to a max of XXL (Gear pieces needed for maximum effect: 3).
